definitions.explanation: Clothes and related textile products, especially in commercial or industrial contexts.

notes:
{衣料|いりょう} refers to clothing, especially in commercial, industrial, or formal contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {衣料|いりょう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (clothing items/products)
- {衣料|いりょう}⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (clothing expenses)
- {衣料|いりょう}⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧ (clothing/apparel industry)

COMPOUNDS:
- {衣料|いりょう}⟦{品店|ひんてん}→品店：noentry⟧ (clothing store)
- {衣料|いりょう}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧ (clothing manufacturer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: clothes (everyday word)
- ⟦{衣服|いふく}→衣服：01825_ifuku⟧: clothing (slightly formal)
- {衣料|いりょう}: clothing/apparel (commercial/industry term)
- ⟦{衣類|いるい}→衣類：04680_irui⟧: clothing, garments (category term)

USAGE:
- More commonly seen in business/commercial contexts
- {衣料|いりょう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ is the standard term in retail
